12	 *   - `OAuthScope` (in `types.ts`) — the compile-time TypeScript union. Token

14	 *     reference this union. Any drift between the union and this registry is

64	 * one floor adjustment: `delete:invoices` rides at `write-high` rather
65	 * than `write-medium` because soft-deleting a billed invoice has
66	 * irreversible accounting consequences in the customer's books.
67	 */

69	  | 'read-low'
70	  | 'read-medium'
71	  | 'read-high'
72	  | 'write-low'
73	  | 'write-medium'

502	/**
503	 * Deterministic ordering for the discovery response. Order:
504	 *   1. Sensitivity class (read-low, read-medium, read-high, write-low,
505	 *      write-medium, write-high) — least-sensitive first so the UI renders
506	 *      safe defaults at the top.
507	 *   2. Within a class: ascending by scope key.
508	 *
509	 * The fixed sort ensures byte-stable responses (CDN-friendly) and stable
510	 * snapshots in tests.
511	 */
512	const SENSITIVITY_ORDER: Record<ScopeSensitivityClass, number> = {
513	  'read-low': 0,
514	  'read-medium': 1,
515	  'read-high': 2,
516	  'write-low': 3,
517	  'write-medium': 4,
518	  'write-high': 5,
519	};

521	/**
522	 * Return the registry as a deterministically-ordered array. Used by the
523	 * discovery handler and by tests that snapshot the registry shape.
524	 *
525	 * NOTE: the returned array is a new array each call (no caller can mutate
526	 * the registry via the response). Entries themselves are the same object
527	 * references — they are deeply frozen by `Object.freeze` at module load.
528	 */
529	export function listScopeRegistry(): ScopeRegistryEntry[] {
530	  return Object.values(SCOPE_REGISTRY)
531	    .slice()
532	    .sort((a, b) => {
533	      const sa = SENSITIVITY_ORDER[a.sensitivity_class];
534	      const sb = SENSITIVITY_ORDER[b.sensitivity_class];
535	      if (sa !== sb) return sa - sb;
536	      return a.key < b.key ? -1 : a.key > b.key ? 1 : 0;
537	    });
538	}

540	/**
541	 * Test-only parity helper. Returns `{ missing, phantom }` arrays so a
542	 * single test can assert both directions of registry ↔ `OAUTH_SCOPES`
543	 * parity. The compile-time `Record<OAuthScope, ...>` already prevents
544	 * drift, but this runtime check guards against (a) future relaxation of
545	 * the registry typing, and (b) `OAUTH_SCOPES` const being out of sync
546	 * with the `OAuthScope` union itself (the const is the array form; the
547	 * union is the type form — they can drift independently if hand-edited).
548	 */
549	export function diffRegistryAgainstScopes(): {
550	  missing: readonly string[];
551	  phantom: readonly string[];
552	} {
553	  const registryKeys = new Set<string>(Object.keys(SCOPE_REGISTRY));
554	  const scopeConst = new Set<string>(OAUTH_SCOPES);
555	  const missing: string[] = [];
556	  const phantom: string[] = [];
557	  for (const k of scopeConst) {
558	    if (!registryKeys.has(k)) missing.push(k);
559	  }
560	  for (const k of registryKeys) {
561	    if (!scopeConst.has(k)) phantom.push(k);
562	  }
563	  return { missing, phantom };
564	}

364	/**
365	 * Deterministic ordering for the discovery response. Order:
366	 *   1. Sensitivity class (write-low, write-medium, write-high) — least-
367	 *      sensitive first so the UI renders safe defaults at the top.
368	 *   2. Within a class: ascending by action key.
369	 *
370	 * The fixed sort ensures byte-stable responses (CDN-friendly) and stable
371	 * snapshots in tests.
372	 */
373	const SENSITIVITY_ORDER: Record<ActionSensitivityClass, number> = {
374	  'write-low': 0,
375	  'write-medium': 1,
376	  'write-high': 2,
377	};
378	
379	/**
380	 * Return the registry as a deterministically-ordered array. Used by the
381	 * discovery handler and by tests that snapshot the registry shape.
382	 *
383	 * NOTE: the returned array is a new array each call (no caller can mutate
384	 * the registry via the response). Entries themselves are shared object
385	 * references — callers should treat them as read-only.
386	 */
387	export function listActionRegistry(): ActionRegistryEntry[] {
388	  return Object.values(ACTION_REGISTRY)
389	    .slice()
390	    .sort((a, b) => {
391	      const sa = SENSITIVITY_ORDER[a.sensitivity_class];
392	      const sb = SENSITIVITY_ORDER[b.sensitivity_class];
393	      if (sa !== sb) return sa - sb;
394	      return a.key < b.key ? -1 : a.key > b.key ? 1 : 0;
395	    });
396	}

425	 * (NULL semantics in Postgres). `status` same. The resolver only overrides a
426	 * field when the override row's column is non-null.
427	 */
428	export interface ActionOverrideRecord {
429	  key: string;
430	  enabled_globally: boolean | null;

432	  deprecated_at: Date | string | null;

436	 * Per-school override shape — what the resolver reads from
437	 * `action_school_overrides`. When present, the per-school `enabled` flag
438	 * supersedes the global `enabled_globally` for that tenant.

441	  key: string;

443	  enabled: boolean;
444	}

446	/**
447	 * Loader contract for the action override store. Two reads:
448	 *   - `loadOverride(key)`: returns the global override row (or null when
449	 *     no row exists; "use registry defaults").
450	 *   - `loadSchoolOverride(key, flightSchoolId)`: returns the per-school
451	 *     row (or null when no row exists).
452	 *
453	 * The DI seam keeps the resolver pure / unit-testable. The DB-backed
454	 * implementation lives next to the W6-2 PATCH backend.
455	 */
456	export interface ActionOverrideStore {
457	  loadOverride(key: string): Promise<ActionOverrideRecord | null>;
458	  loadSchoolOverride(
459	    key: string,
460	    flightSchoolId: string,
461	  ): Promise<ActionSchoolOverrideRecord | null>;
462	}
463	
464	/**
465	 * Return the merged view of a registry entry by `key`. Returns `null` when
466	 * the key is not present in `ACTION_REGISTRY` (caller must treat this as
467	 * 404 / "unknown action").
468	 *
469	 * Merge precedence (low → high):
470	 *   1. `ACTION_REGISTRY[key]` — compile-time default.
471	 *   2. `action_overrides[key]` — super-admin global override.
472	 *   3. `action_school_overrides[(key, flightSchoolId)]` — per-tenant override
473	 *      (only when `flightSchoolId` is supplied AND a row exists). Per-school
474	 *      override only affects `enabled_globally`; lifecycle `status` lives
475	 *      exclusively on the global row.
476	 *
477	 * Pure when `store` is omitted — returns the raw registry entry wrapped in
478	 * `ResolvedAction` shape with `source: 'registry'` and `deprecated_at: null`.
479	 * This keeps the existing callers (discovery procedure) cheap; the route
480	 * gate must pass a store to get real enforcement.
481	 */
482	export async function getAction(
483	  key: string,
484	  options?: {
485	    store?: ActionOverrideStore;
486	    flightSchoolId?: string;
487	  },
488	): Promise<ResolvedAction | null> {
489	  const entry = ACTION_REGISTRY[key];
490	  if (!entry) return null;
491	
492	  let enabledGlobally = entry.enabled_globally;
493	  let status: ActionStatus = entry.status;
494	  let deprecatedAt: string | null = null;
495	  let enabledSource: 'registry' | 'override' = 'registry';
496	  let statusSource: 'registry' | 'override' = 'registry';
497	
498	  const store = options?.store;
499	  if (store) {
500	    const globalOverride = await store.loadOverride(key);
501	    if (globalOverride) {
502	      if (globalOverride.enabled_globally !== null) {
503	        enabledGlobally = globalOverride.enabled_globally;
504	        enabledSource = 'override';
505	      }
506	      if (globalOverride.status !== null) {
507	        status = globalOverride.status;
508	        statusSource = 'override';
509	      }
510	      if (globalOverride.deprecated_at) {
511	        deprecatedAt =
512	          typeof globalOverride.deprecated_at === 'string'
513	            ? globalOverride.deprecated_at
514	            : globalOverride.deprecated_at.toISOString();
515	      }
516	    }
517	
518	    const flightSchoolId = options?.flightSchoolId;
519	    if (flightSchoolId) {
520	      const schoolOverride = await store.loadSchoolOverride(
521	        key,
522	        flightSchoolId,
523	      );
524	      if (schoolOverride) {
525	        enabledGlobally = schoolOverride.enabled;
526	        enabledSource = 'override';
527	      }
528	    }
529	  }
530	
531	  return {
532	    ...entry,
533	    enabled_globally: enabledGlobally,
534	    status,
535	    deprecated_at: deprecatedAt,
536	    source: {
537	      enabled_globally: enabledSource,
538	      status: statusSource,
539	    },
540	  };
541	}
